summary.text: Shelly Short is a Republican member of the Washington State Senate representing District 7, where she took office in 2017, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election against Ronald McCoy of the Independent Party.
She previously served in the state House from 2009 to 2017, including as Minority Caucus Vice Chair and Minority Caucus Leader.

paragraphs.text: Shelly Short studied liberal arts at Spokane Community College from 1980 to 1981 and international business at Eastern Washington University from 1981 to 1982.
She worked as a legal secretary and paralegal in a series of law offices between 1985 and 1994.

Short then worked for Congressman George Nethercutt from 1994 to 2004 as a field coordinator, as deputy district director for Congresswoman Cathy McMorris-Rodgers from 2004 to 2006, and as senior legislative assistant to State Representative Joel Kretz from 2006 to 2008.

Short served as a Republican precinct committee officer in Stevens County and as secretary of the Seventh District Legislative Committee from 1997 to 2003 and of the Stevens County Republican Central Committee from 1999 to 2005.
She represented District 7, Position 1, in the Washington House of Representatives from 2009 to 2017, then moved to the Senate in 2017.
